mistakes.title: Missing decoupling capacitor
mistakes.explanation: U1 has a power pin on net '+1V2', but no bypass/decoupling capacitor connects that net to a recognized ground return. Without local decoupling, supply transients from switching current can couple into the IC and cause glitches, resets, or radiated noise.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Add a decoupling capacitor (typically 100nF, or per the datasheet) from +1V2 to the nearest ground return, placed within a few mm of U1's power pin.

mistakes.title: Differential pair length mismatch
mistakes.explanation: MIPI_CLK_P is 29.1mm, MIPI_CLK_N is 21.3mm (7.8mm difference). Differential requires < 5.0mm length difference to maintain signal timing. Mismatched lengths cause timing skew that degrades signal quality.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Add serpentine to MIPI_CLK_N to match MIPI_CLK_P length, or shorten the MIPI_CLK_P routing path. Target: 29.1mm for both traces.

mistakes.title: Differential pair length mismatch
mistakes.explanation: MIPI_DAT1_P is 29.0mm, MIPI_DAT1_N is 15.4mm (13.5mm difference). Differential requires < 5.0mm length difference to maintain signal timing. Mismatched lengths cause timing skew that degrades signal quality.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Add serpentine to MIPI_DAT1_N to match MIPI_DAT1_P length, or shorten the MIPI_DAT1_P routing path. Target: 29.0mm for both traces.

mistakes.title: Power trace too narrow
mistakes.explanation: Power trace on +1V2 is only 0.20mm wide. Narrow power traces cause voltage drop and can overheat under load. For 1A at 1oz copper, traces should be at least 0.5mm wide.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Increase trace width on +1V2 to at least 0.3mm, or use a copper pour for power distribution. Consider the expected current draw.

mistakes.title: Via in SMD pad
mistakes.explanation: Via found in SMD pad B1 of U4. During reflow soldering, solder can wick down into the via, resulting in insufficient solder on the pad and unreliable connections.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Move the via outside the pad area, or specify via-in-pad with filled and capped vias in the manufacturing notes. Via-in-pad increases cost but is acceptable when properly filled.

mistakes.title: Acute angle in trace (acid trap)
mistakes.explanation: Trace on A2 (F.Cu) has a 90° angle. Angles less than 90° can trap etchant during PCB manufacturing, causing over-etching at the vertex. This can weaken the trace and cause reliability issues.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Reroute the trace to use 45° or 90° angles instead. If the acute angle is unavoidable, add a teardrop at the junction to eliminate the sharp corner.

mistakes.title: Differential pair length matching could be improved
mistakes.explanation: DQS_P/DQS_N have 4.6mm length difference. While within spec (5.0mm max), better matching improves signal integrity margin.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Consider adding serpentine to improve length matching. Current: 20.4mm / 25.0mm.
